task: Copyedit this internal handoff note for a colleague preparing a fictional lecture programme. It already distinguishes a confirmed topic from an unapproved title. Keep the practical next action and justified uncertainty; return the note unchanged if no meaningful correction is needed.
input: The speaker has confirmed the topic: the history of festival posters. The title is still open. For internal planning, we are using Posters on the Wall, but please do not put that wording in the printed programme yet. Before the programme goes to print on Friday, ask the speaker to approve a title. The topic itself does not need another confirmation.

facts.text: The fictional speaker has confirmed the topic as the history of festival posters.
No lecture title has been approved.
Posters on the Wall is an internal working title only.
The programme goes to print on Friday.
The colleague should obtain title approval before printing.

forbidden_additions: The working title presented as approved for publication.
A new title, changed lecture topic, or claim that the speaker was contacted.
An unnecessary requirement to reconfirm the already confirmed topic.
preserve: Different approval states for the topic and title.
The specific handoff action before Friday's print deadline.
The clear note without cosmetic rewriting.
